title: [Main][All-E][Repair Item] Posted Purchase Invoice Order No. is blank when invoice rounding creates a generated line
summary: Posted purchase invoice now correctly shows the Order No. from the source purchase order even when invoice rounding creates a system-generated line.
key_points: System-generated invoice rounding lines are now excluded when checking if all lines belong to the same purchase order
Ensures Order No. is properly copied to posted purchase invoice headers
Other lines with blank or different Order No. values still prevent header population
Regression tests added for single-order, multiple-order, and manual-line scenarios
quote: Ignore valid system-generated invoice rounding lines when determining whether all posted purchase invoice lines belong to the same purchase order.
